name: kitab-allah-encyclopedia
description: Connects Claude to the Encyclopedia of the Great Quran (kitab-allah.org), from the works of Dr. Ratib Al-Samman: the author's lexical entries on Quranic words, his topics encyclopedia and works, the roots of the Quran with classical lexicons, and a skill that teaches Claude to cite them exactly and keep the author, the lexicons, the corpus data and its own words apart.
